turns.q: I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.
turns.replyTail:
I completely understand wanting to feel confident before buying, especially after being disappointed by similar products. Our pieces are gold- or silver-plated over base metal, with an added anti-tarnish layer. They’re shower-safe, sweat-safe, nickel-free, and hypoallergenic, but the plating can wear over time with contact from perfume, lotion, chlorine, or cleaning products.

Which product are you considering? I can help you check the details that matter most for it 😊
